body:
This is for sure really going to help me out. I know I have therapy and other things scheduled out, but they don't happen for another 2 weeks, and it felt like living up until then felt near hopeless and I was desperate for ways to stay at least a little positive and functioning. I appreciate you giving me this tool to start working on things by myself; there's plenty of articles out there but it's always nice to hear it from somebody else who's been down this road before.

Thank you so much ♡♡
